**Finding: compliant** (meets the preferred position on material terms).

- **Warranty scope** — §9(b) gives Vendor-side express warranties covering all four preferred elements: performance to industry standards (p0034), services free from errors materially affecting utility (p0038), no malicious code (p0036), and compliance with applicable Laws (p0041).
- **Duration** — no 12-month/90-day cut-off; the warranties run "throughout the Term," which exceeds the preferred period.
- **Disclaimer does not swallow it** — §13 (p0062) opens "Except as expressly set forth herein" and expressly excepts "the representations and warranties set forth in this Agreement," so this is not the "AS IS" walk-away case.
- **Remedy** — no repair/replace/refund sentence, but equally no sole/exclusive-remedy language anywhere, so we keep full remedies at law plus the §4(b) cure-and-terminate right. Inserting the model remedy would *cap* our recovery at Vendor's option, so I deliberately left it alone and noted it in the rationale.
- Minor, non-flagged notes: "industry standards"/material-error framing instead of express conformance-to-documentation, and no separate "professional and workmanlike" formulation.

No redline proposed, consistent with the instruction not to redline clauses that already benefit our party.
